purpose: Defines digest-validated input fixtures for annotator calibration. Loads camera geometry from tracked homography and resolution data, constructs three Fixture instances representing badminton matches with tracked positions and ground truth, and validates external fixture files against MD5 digests to prevent silent data corruption.

public_api.name: FilePin
public_api.role: Dataclass storing path, MD5 digest, and root location for one tracked file; used to pin external files against bit-for-bit changes.

public_api.name: CalibrationGeometry
public_api.role: Dataclass holding derived camera-space court bounds, net band, and video resolution for one fixture.

public_api.name: FixtureDigests
public_api.role: Dataclass holding nine MD5 digests for one fixture's external files in fixed order; passed to Fixture constructor.

public_api.name: Fixture
public_api.role: Dataclass representing all inputs for one scoring fixture; name, video ID, FPS, geometry, and file digests; properties derive paths from name.

public_api.name: fixtures_root
public_api.role: Returns the external fixture root directory from ANNOTATOR_FIXTURES_ROOT environment variable; called to resolve fixture file locations.

public_api.name: verify_file
public_api.role: Asserts one pinned file exists and matches its recorded MD5 digest; called before using fixture files.

public_api.name: verify_fixture
public_api.role: Validates that all nine external files named by a fixture exist with correct MD5 digests; top-level validation entry point.

public_api.name: SSET_01
public_api.role: Pre-built Fixture instance for Wave 1 calibration (Kento MOMOTA match); exposed at module level for test imports.

public_api.name: SSET_15
public_api.role: Pre-built Fixture instance for Wave 1 calibration (Anthony GINTING match); exposed at module level for test imports.

public_api.name: SSET_21
public_api.role: Pre-built Fixture instance for Wave 1 calibration (An Se Young match); exposed at module level for test imports.

public_api.name: FIXTURES
public_api.role: Tuple collecting the three pre-built Fixture instances; provides unified access to all Wave 1 fixtures.

public_api.name: SHARED_FILES
public_api.role: Tuple of FilePin entries for repository-local files (CSVs) shared across fixtures; used for validation.
